cross_calibration.note: Published relative calibration uses this later window; it is not simultaneous eclipse imaging.

inversion: Published pB line-of-sight Thomson-scattering density inversion with stated spherical-symmetry assumption; do not reinterpret the measured pB as point electron density.

density_samples.provenance: Data Availability section directs requests to corresponding author; no machine-readable density array/covariance has been obtained.

uncertainty_status: Full sample covariance and calibration uncertainty not acquired; published polarizer-angle sensitivity is not adopted as an observational tolerance.
actual_KCor_daily_radial_scan: reference/20201214.kcor.radial.intensity.txt contains azimuthal-mean brightness, not either directional density curve.
